module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder -150) that tracks the vehicles used by a graph: those it spawns or those declared to it with addForeignVehicle. It waits for each vehicle to be ready, retrieves the offsets of its couplers (tow_hitch, fifthwheel...), tracks couplings between vehicles, manages bus data (kneeling, doors, stops) and deletes the vehicles when the graph stops except those marked dontDelete. Depends on gameplay_walk and core_vehicleBridge.
usage:
local vm = mgr.modules.vehicle
local id = vm:getVehicleIdByInternalName('mon_vehicule')
if vm:isBus(id) then vm:registerBusChangeNotification(id) end
notes: Hooks listened to: onCouplerAttached, onCouplerDetached, onBusUpdate, onVehicleResetted (onBusUpdate has no method in this file).
getVehicle returns an empty table (never nil) if the id is unknown.
Possible bug: onCouplerAttached/onCouplerDetached crash if one of the two ids is not tracked (self.couplings[id] is nil).
requestBusData is empty (its content is commented out); the function does nothing.
Coupler priority order for the couplerOffset sort: tow_hitch, fifthwheel, gooseneck_hitch, fifthwheel_v2, pintle. More than one coupler on a vehicle generates an I log.
executionStopped: deletes non-dontDelete vehicles, restores the stored fuel of the others, restores the gameplay_walk blacklist and the core_trailerRespawn state.

C.desc: Vehicle module instance (mgr.modules.vehicle). Internal tables: vehicles (id -> data: id, ready, internalName, couplerOffset, couplerTags, dontDelete, storedEnergyStorage...), sortedIds (sorted ids), couplings (id -> {otherId = true}).

init.desc: Creates the internal tables then calls clear().

getSpawnedVehicles.desc: Deep copy of the sorted list of tracked vehicle ids.

addForeignVehicle.desc: Declares a vehicle not created by the flowgraph but to be tracked; it is marked dontDelete (not deleted on stop).

moreData.desc: additional fields merged into the data

addVehicle.desc: Starts tracking a vehicle (ignored if already tracked). If the vehicle is ready, calls readyUpVehicle.

getVehicle.desc: Returns a vehicle's tracked data, or an empty table.

getVehicleIdByInternalName.desc: Looks up a vehicle's id by its exact internal name.

getVehiclesIdByInternalNameMatch.desc: Returns the ids whose internal name matches the pattern (string.find, so a Lua pattern).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: detects vehicles that have become ready and calls readyUpVehicle.

readyUpVehicle.desc: Marks the vehicle ready; unless ignoreReadyUp, enables mapmgr tracking (via the level module, possibly deferred) and requests the coupler offsets for each tag.

addCouplerOffset.desc: Records the received coupler offsets (vec3, name, tag) for a vehicle and sorts them by tag priority then by name.

executionStarted.desc: Stores the gameplay_walk blacklist and the core_trailerRespawn state to restore them on stop.

storeFuelAmount.desc: Requests and stores the energy of the vehicle's tanks, to restore it on stop (if it is not deleted). W log if the vehicle is not tracked.

setKeepVehicle.desc: Sets dontDelete for a tracked vehicle; if it is in a prefab, asks the prefab module to unpack it before deletion.

keep.desc: true to not delete it on stop

executionStopped.desc: Called when the graph stops: deletes non-dontDelete vehicles, restores the energy of the others, the walking blacklist and core_trailerRespawn, then clear().

onCouplerAttached.desc: Hook: records the coupling between two vehicles (in both directions).

onCouplerDetached.desc: Hook: removes the coupling between two vehicles.

isCoupled.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is coupled to at least one other.

returns.desc: non-nil (truthy) value if coupled, otherwise nil

isCoupledTo.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle is coupled to the vehicle other.

requestBusData.desc: Does nothing: the body (sending bus_onTriggerTick) is commented out.

updateBusDisplayData.desc: Sends the vehicle the bus_onRouteChange event with the route display data.

data.desc: serialized data sent to the controller

registerBusChangeNotification.desc: Asks core_vehicleBridge to be notified of changes to the vehicle's "kneel" and "dooropen".

isBusKneel.desc: Indicates whether the bus is kneeling (cached value 'kneel' == 1).

isBusDoorOpen.desc: Indicates whether the bus door is open (cached value 'dooropen' == 1).

requestBusStop.desc: Sends the bus the bus_onSetStopRequest event (stop request).

isBus.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle's model has the "Bus" Body Style.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is reset; relays to activity:onVehicleReset(id) if the activity exists.
